Hidden Gems // Field Guide

Field Guide

Hidden Gem
A player whose underlying traits look stronger than the public-facing results currently suggest.
Latent Alpha
Unpriced upside that may not yet be reflected in roster rate, ownership, or visible surface stats.
Ballistic Breakout
A profile where movement, shape, power, or impact quality is beginning to point toward a stronger future result set.
Divergence
The gap between strong underlying traits and weaker box-score outcomes. This is the core Hidden Gems lens.
Under-the-Hood Elite
A player whose deeper traits are materially stronger than their recent public perception.
Trait Score
A composite measure of underlying quality, such as shape, whiff, velocity, or impact traits.
Divergence Score
A measure of how much the player’s visible results lag their deeper trait profile.
Market Score
A rough estimate of how overlooked the player still appears to be relative to the strength of the profile.
Ballistics vs Surface
The sparkline area is meant to frame the relationship between rising underlying quality and slower-moving public results.
Low Market Price
A player who may still be available cheaply because the market has not fully recognized the profile yet.
